scope: Finite semantic review of pooled capital intensity, outsourced custom silicon, and economic-owner cash versus issuer adjusted FCF. No alternative equity valuation and no change to assumptions.

verdict.reason: A blended capital coefficient applied to a mixed business is an assumption requiring calibration, not itself an accounting duplication. Public primary sources do not establish that all purpose-built silicon or all Other DCAI is externally fabricated, nor disclose the relevant future mix. No support found for deleting the associated capital allowance while keeping all operating margins unchanged.
verdict.remaining_model_limitation: Host sales-to-net-capital of0.80 is an aggregate long-run judgment. It may overstate or understate future requirements as internal/external mix changes. A business-level manufacturing and capital split would improve interpretation; this pass does not identify a defensible replacement coefficient.
verdict.implication_for_long_test: The identified mapping issue is not a new free-cash-flow uplift that rescues LONG. Continue earnings attribution using existing physical investment and separately identify what evidence would justify a mix-based capital revision.

primary_findings.locator: Note 2 Operating Segments; Intel Products/Intel Foundry definitions
primary_findings.fact: Products expenses include both internal Foundry charges and external foundry/manufacturing costs. Internal transfer revenue and profit are eliminated on consolidation. Foundry contains manufacturing and technology-development costs.
primary_findings.interpretation: Summing product and Foundry operating income with consolidation adjustments can be consistent; paying external foundries is an operating expense, not evidence of a duplicated own-fab capital cash payment.

primary_findings.locator: MD&A Intel Products and Intel Foundry
primary_findings.fact: DCAI includes CPUs, accelerators, NICs, IPUs and purpose-built silicon. Products are manufactured by Intel Foundry and, to a lesser extent, third-party manufacturers. Substantially all current Foundry activity supports internal Products.
primary_findings.interpretation: Other DCAI is not a disclosed pure ASIC or pure fabless segment. Aggregate statements do not identify custom-silicon wafer sourcing or its2030/2040mix.

primary_findings.fact: Intel describes developing ASICs/design services and combining product/design capability with manufacturing; it also uses third-party manufacturing.
primary_findings.interpretation: This supports multiple possible business models, not a measured asset-light capital ratio for future Other DCAI.

primary_findings.fact: Most consolidated depreciation is incurred by Foundry and absorbed through inventory; Intel says depreciation within each Products segment cannot practicably be determined.
primary_findings.interpretation: The current20%-of-Products D&A normalization is not a disclosed product-level physical depreciation schedule.

primary_findings.locator: Explanation of Non-GAAP Measures; cash flow reconciliation
primary_findings.fact: Issuer adjusted FCF starts from consolidated operating cash flow and adjusts for gross capital additions, capital-related government receipts, net SCIP partner contributions and finance-lease payments.
primary_findings.interpretation: It is a liquidity measure that can include external funding and SBC accounting addbacks. It is not identical to parent-attributable economic unlevered cash.

capital_identity.current_host_rule: Physical gross capex = normalized D&A + incremental host sales /0.80 - incremental operating working capital; WC is10% of incremental host sales.
capital_identity.cash_identity: D&A - capex - deltaWC = -incremental host sales/0.80. Therefore D&A is not an additional independent reinvestment penalty once this identity is applied.
capital_identity.semantic_guard: Reducing D&A and capex together while holding EBIT fixed leaves this operating-cash component unchanged. A genuine reduction in depreciation burden could change EBIT, taxes and cash, but it must follow a paired asset-cost and outsourcing forecast. Do not simply subtract D&A20% as an avoidable duplicate.
capital_identity.scope: Near-term2027-2030 physical capital is separately budgeted. Host coefficient applies from2031. External packaging has its own funded capital schedule and is not charged host turnover again.

Other_DCAI_exposure_diagnostic.interpretation: Allocation under a blended rule only. These amounts are not proved avoidable; a fabless business still has design assets, working capital, supplier prepayments, packaging and outsourced manufacturing cost.

revenue_denominator.issue: The capital denominator is Products sales plus root Other sales plus the separate net packaging overlay. Embedded external Foundry sales are not fully reconstructed as a consolidated revenue schedule.
revenue_denominator.effect: Do not compare the capital denominator directly with analyst GAAP revenue, or infer that the absence of a separate revenue line means related costs were duplicated. Correcting the scope could increase or decrease appropriately attributed growth capital; it is not automatically a positive valuation adjustment.
revenue_denominator.no_large_external_wafer_option: No extra major external wafer customer revenue or profit is adopted by this review.

economic_to_issuer_FCF_bridge.starting_point: Use current owner cash AFTER ordinary financing and incentives. Do not start with unlevered cash and omit the separate ordinary interest, capitalized interest, cash-income tax and financing-tax effects.
economic_to_issuer_FCF_bridge.symbolic_formula: Issuer-style adjusted FCF proxy = economic owner cash after financing + recurring economic SBC + minority economic reserve + net actual partner contributions + remaining cash/book/classification timing adjustments.
economic_to_issuer_FCF_bridge.net_partner_definition: Partner cash contributions minus actual partner cash distributions; future NCI income/reserve is not the same as distributions.

annual_diagnostics.scope: Illustrative issuer-style adjusted FCF proxy, not a forecast of legal partner distributions, fully reconstructed GAAP CFO or a new equity-cash measure. Existing economic cash and valuation stay unchanged.

economic_to_issuer_FCF_bridge.SBC: Accounting CFO restores noncash compensation; our economic owner cash deliberately charges it. Restoring SBC for comparison does not create extra shareholder cash or justify a DCF uplift. Avoid simultaneously charging full equivalent compensation and adding full dilution for the same future grants.
economic_to_issuer_FCF_bridge.minorities: Consolidated CFO begins before NCI attribution. Restore the economic reserve to compare with consolidated cash and deduct actual partner distributions only where included in the issuer metric; do not deduct both the reserve and the same payment.
economic_to_issuer_FCF_bridge.lease_cash: The forward1B allowance is all-in cash, not a measured finance-lease-principal schedule. Actual issuer FCF deducts finance-lease principal while lease interest is within CFO. Preserve total cash once; cannot claim exact CFO or a precise book-interest split from this allowance.
economic_to_issuer_FCF_bridge.cash_PPE: Total cash PPE includes investing-classified purchases plus financing-classified extended-term payments. ForQ3,4.024B+0.195B=4.219B. ForYTD,10.216B+1.618B=11.834B. Do not add extended payments again after using total cash PPE.
economic_to_issuer_FCF_bridge.capitalized_interest: Current physical cash capex excludes1B annual capitalized interest; treasury subtracts that1B as financing cash. An issuer gross-PPE comparison restores it to the capital classification, without changing total cash. Its later book depreciation/tax treatment must be reconciled separately for earnings.
economic_to_issuer_FCF_bridge.capital_tax: Existing finite receivable collections and new eligible project credit cash already enter economic cash once, with a basis-loss tax convention. Depending on cash-flow classification, refunds/credits can appear in CFO or capital incentives; do not add them again when mapping the total. The model is not a reconstructed book-tax statement.
economic_to_issuer_FCF_bridge.adjusted_EPS_to_cash_guard: If starting from adjusted NI, first reverse excluded SBC, acquisition amortization, restructuring, non-GAAP tax normalization and NCI adjustments to recover the economic earnings basis. Total D&A already contains corporate acquisition amortization and assumed lease-asset depreciation. Adjusted NI plus full D&A can double count an amortization addback.

evidence_needed_to_change_capital_policy: Disclosed internal versus external fabrication and packaging by relevant product/customer program, with accepted shipment or revenue mix.
A matched spending/working-capital schedule and cash wafer/service costs: outsourcing may replace capex with operating costs and advance payments.
Incremental tool/site capacity actually avoided or redeployed; future revenue growth alone does not prove existing factories can be retired without stranded costs.
Reconcile Products, external Foundry, Other and packaging revenues before applying product-specific capital ratios; preserve internal-transfer eliminations.
Revise margin, depreciation, cash tax, capex and working capital together, and keep partner/customer financing with its associated claims.
